note: Independent re-judgment after 562bc0139d against RFC 4271 Section 4.2 ("The Hold Time MUST be either zero or at least three seconds."). The only change to writeMessageHeld is a step that rewrites a *message.Notification (a type assertion; Notification is the only message type whose Type() is NOTIFICATION) through notificationWithinPeerLimit; the OPEN that TestRFC4271OpenHoldTimeOnWire captures passes through untouched. The other units the stale check named changed in other commits without touching the Hold Time path: NewSession (a27a951239 connectionID, 6b82e4d05d LocalAddr zone) and peer_settings.go (19f7349896 Description field). The tests are unchanged: the wire test reads the raw Hold Time octets of sendOpen's real output (default 90, configured 0 and 3) and fails on a nonzero value below 3; TestOpenValidateHoldTime's negative requires 1 and 2 refused with OPEN Message Error / Unacceptable Hold Time; its positive is a supplementary policy contract, since Section 6.2 lets an implementation reject any value. The prior discrimination records still describe these unchanged units.
